research.notes: The company's contact page lists only individual consultants' phone numbers and Gmail addresses and no general line or inbox, so phone and email were left null. The company's own pages do not mention Oakland or OUSD; identity rests on the exact name, the Eugene, OR location and the matching line of work. profile.summary: An education consulting company that provides training, coaching and program design services to schools. Its work includes project-based learning, curriculum design, teacher professional development and whole-school reform planning.

sources.title: Project Based Learning | Swanson and Cosgrave | Home

review.notes: The contact page shows the exact legal name 'Swanson & Cosgrave Consulting, LLC' at a Eugene, OR mailing address, which matches the agenda vendor and location. The About and Home pages support the neutral summary (project-based learning, curriculum design, teacher PD, whole-school reform, CTE), which fits a Linked Learning contract. Individuals' phones and emails were correctly left out.
